comparisons.reason: Feature 0 is an any-presence test: it returns 1 if at least one flat, universal or categorical statement appears, and hedging elsewhere is irrelevant (its spec says both features can be 1 for the same row). Feature 1 is a global test for unwavering certainty: it returns 0 if any explicit hedge or self-doubt marker appears anywhere, and it also requires an overall categorical framing. An argument with one absolute statement and one hedge scores 1 on feature 0 and 0 on feature 1. The two therefore have different eligibility and exclusion rules and different row functions.
